Final for Publication

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
4125 and 4127 West 5" Avenue
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property
The subject property is situated in a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District on the south
side of West 5 Avenue. It is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 1,150 feet from the CTA Pulaski
Blue Line Station Entrance.

The property is one zoning lot comprised of two vacant parcels that includes Lot 10, also known as 4127 West
5" Avenue and Lot 11, also known as 4125 West 5" Avenue.

The Project
TECHCO SAVVY INC. (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to split the lots into two individual

zoning lots to allow construction of one three-story building on each lot (approx. 36.0 foot height). The
buildings will each include three dwelling units, two surface parking spaces, and three bicycle spaces.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from an RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District to an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

As part of the rezoning application, the Applicant also seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, through a Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) and also including: 1) an optional variation
under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the east side yard setbacks per section 17-2-0309 on Lots 10 and 11 from
2.0 feet to 0.65 feet; 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the combined side yard
setbacks per section 17-2-0309 on Lots 10 and 11 from 5.0 feet to 3.65 feet; and 3) an optional variation under
section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback per section 17-2-0306 on Lots 10 and 11 from 37.50 feet to
34.87 feet.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot 11: 2,956.17 square feet

Lot 11: 1,248

Lot 11: 3

Lot 11: 985.3 square feet
Height: Lot 10: 36.0 feet
Lot 11: 36.0 feet
Automobile Parking: Lot 10: 2
Lot 11: 2
Bicycle Parking: Lot 10: 3

Lot 11: 3
